hypothesis: Equal percentile-rank averaging of scratch-crop and pretrained-feature pair heads can improve high-precision division recall through complementary errors.
single_candidate: Exact 0.50/0.50 rank average and unchanged evaluator; no alternate blend. The launcher feature SHA is unit-checked against the immutable EXP160 raw result.
external_gate: All 64 external validation shards; proposal ceiling at least 0.90; ensemble precision at least 0.50 and recall at least 0.20; report component and ensemble AP plus correlation.
competition_gate: No competition data unless the external gate passes; reciprocal source gate precedes any prospective target pass.
implementation_tests: Four focused launcher and ensemble tests passed. Remote bash -n is mandatory after staging.
resource: One RTX6000 through common queue; 8 CPU, 32 GiB RAM, 2 GiB disk, 20 minutes.
